input.title: UI/UX Designer
input.text:
Company Description
About Playtech
Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.
As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: www.playtechpeople.com and www.playtech.com
Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.
Join our Design Team – Where Fun Meets Innovation!
At Playtech, we thrive on delivering fun and exciting Player experiences – and connect with players worldwide through our cutting-edge platforms. We’re looking for passionate innovators who can contribute to Playtech’s development and delivery of top-quality iGaming products, interactive community engagement like real-time chat and customer experiences.
Ready to shape the future of online gaming?
We’re looking for a proactive, detail-driven UI/UX Designer to help elevate our design standards and contribute meaningfully to product development.
This isn’t just about making things look good — you’ll play a key role in improving how we work, balancing thoughtful user-centred design with the speed required of a fast-paced environment.
Job Description
Your influential mission. You will...
• Design visually appealing and user-friendly interfaces across web and mobile platforms.
• Develop wireframes and interactive prototypes.
• Collaborate with product and engineering to shape great user-experiences.
• Support end-to-end design delivery — from concept through to design commit and developer handoff.
• Help improve design processes and advocate for best practices in collaboration and iteration.
• Balance speed and attention to detail, adapting to changing priorities and fast-paced delivery.
• Jump in where needed to support broader creative or product-related tasks.
Qualifications
Components for success. You...
• Have 3+ years of experience in UI design, ideally with some UX awareness or involvement.
• Are proficient in Figma and are comfortable working within established design systems.
• Have a working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.).
• Understand layout, typography, and visual hierarchy — and apply them with consistency.
• Can balance quick delivery with polished, high-quality output.
• Communicate effectively and collaborate well with other designers, developers, and product teams.
• Are proactive, detail-oriented, and take ownership of your work.
You'll get extra points for...
• Experience in gaming.
• Understanding of front-end technologies and accessibility.
• Familiarity with Spine or animation tools is a plus.
• A degree in design or a relevant field (preferred but not required).
Additional Information
Thrive in a culture that values...
• Initiative-taking and confident approach at the workplace.
• Global scope and inclusive working environment.
• Constant learning and development opportunities.
• Active lifestyle and mental well-being.
• Fun and engaging company events.
How We Measure Success?
• Engagement & Collaboration: Strong feedback from team and stakeholders.
• User Impact: Measurable UX improvements from research and testing.
• Quality & Delivery: Designs meet high standards and deadlines.
• Growth & Development: Clear career paths and continuous learning.
• Leadership & Support: A motivated, well-guided design team.
THINK YOU’D BE A GREAT FIT?
At Playtech, we celebrate diversity and believe inclusive teams create the best experiences. We welcome people from all backgrounds—what matters most is your passion and potential.
You don’t need to tick every box—if this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you!
Apply now with your CV and portfolio.
Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.
